name: The Fate of Yenniku

meta.previous: Speaking with Gan'zulah, Speaking with Nezzliok (Classic)

summary: At Grom'gol Base Camp, Nezzliok's head speaks of Yenniku from the cauldron. Kin'weelay waits beside it for the spirit's words.

sections.title: Words from the Kettle
sections.body: You've appeased the spirits of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok. Now Nezzliok's head speaks from the bubbling cauldron. Kin'weelay waits beside it to hear the secret.

sections.title: What the Head Revealed
sections.body: Nezzliok names Zanzil the Outcast, a witch doctor, as the one who took Yenniku from his clan. Strong magic alone can free the boy from Zanzil's binding. Kin'weelay hears the words, with only a faint hope left.

faq.answer: Nezzliok's head speaks through the bubbling cauldron and tells what happened to Yenniku.

faq.q: Who should be informed of Nezzliok's words?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay waits beside the bubbling cauldron at the northern edge of Grom'gol Base Camp. Nezzliok's words are meant for Kin'weelay.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know the Darkspear tribe and its allies at Grom'gol Base Camp care deeply about recovering the chief's son.
